description: BK — mã quyết định xử phạt, join anchor cho Fact lookup (PK nguồn VARCHAR2 UUID)
Tên hành vi vi phạm của QĐ — ưu tiên nhánh chính (qua đối tượng bị xử phạt) trước nhánh phụ (qua biên bản vi phạm liên kết) trước khi gộp 'Khác'.
etl_logic: LEFT JOIN penalty_decision_subject ON penalty_decision_subject.pd_id = penalty_decision.pd_id AND penalty_decision_subject.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT' LEFT JOIN pd_subject_behavior ON pd_subject_behavior.pd_subject_id = penalty_decision_subject.pd_subject_id AND pd_subject_behavior.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_DECISION_SUBJECT_BEHAVIOR' LEFT JOIN violation_behavior vb ON vb.violation_behavior_id = pd_subject_behavior.violation_behavior_id AND vb.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_VIOLATION_BEHAVIOR' LEFT JOIN penalty_decision_x_violation_record pdvr ON pdvr.pd_id = penalty_decision.pd_id AND pdvr.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_DECISION_VIOLATION_RECORD' LEFT JOIN violation_record vr ON vr.violation_record_id = pdvr.violation_record_id AND vr.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_VIOLATION_RECORD' LEFT JOIN violation_record_behavior vrb ON vrb.violation_record_id = vr.violation_record_id AND vrb.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_VIOLATION_RECORD_BEHAVIOR' LEFT JOIN violation_behavior vb2 ON vb2.violation_behavior_id = vrb.violation_behavior_id AND vb2.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_VIOLATION_BEHAVIOR' → CASE WHEN vb.violation_behavior_nm IS NOT NULL THEN vb.violation_behavior_nm WHEN vb2.violation_behavior_nm IS NOT NULL THEN vb2.violation_behavior_nm ELSE 'Khác' END
